image_description: A close-up photograph of a common iguana (Iguana iguana) in profile view, facing left. The iguana's head, neck, and upper body are visible, showing its characteristic triangular head shape, large eye, subtympanic shield, and dorsal crest spines. The background is dark and blurred, suggesting a natural or terrarium environment.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is large and triangular with a prominent dewlap (loose skin fold) hanging from the throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible in profile, showing a triangular shape. A dewlap is visible hanging from the throat area, though partially obscured by the angle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large with round pupils and golden irises.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is clearly visible, large, with a round pupil. The iris appears golden/brownish, consistent with the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: A large circular subtympanic shield (scale) is present below the tympanum.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large, circular scale is clearly visible below the ear area (tympanum), matching the description of the subtympanic shield.
The visible portion of the body appears robust and muscular, consistent with an adult iguana.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coloration is bright green in juveniles, becoming darker green to greyish-green in adults with broad black bands on the body and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The iguana shows greyish-green coloration with darker banding patterns visible on the body, consistent with an adult.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Row of enlarged, spine-like scales running from the nape along the midline of the back to the tail base, forming a serrated crest.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal crest spines are clearly visible running along the back from the nape, forming the characteristic serrated appearance.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is covered in small, granular scales with larger, plate-like scales on the head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin texture shows small granular scales on the body and larger plate-like scales on the head, matching the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are long and muscular with five clawed digits on each foot.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The limbs are not clearly visible in this close-up shot; only a small portion of the front limb area is visible, making it impossible to verify the five clawed digits.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and longer than body, used for balance and defense.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is not visible in this close-up head and upper body shot.
